title: The Missing Smile
tagline: Steal back the smile that blinded you.
inspiredBy: the 1911 theft of the Mona Lisa from the Louvre

client.intro.a.speaker: client
text: Owl, it is Theo. I need that Laughing Widow portrait out of the Meridian tonight.

client.intro.b.speaker: client
text: You get Marlow inside after closing, and I pay double, no questions asked.

client.intro.c.speaker: client
text: One rule, boss to client. Never look inside the frame, just bring it to me.

client.intro.repeat.speaker: client
text: Same building. Same job. Bring me the laughing widow, Owl.

marlow.intro.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I am inside the foyer. I hear the radiators ticking and smell old polish ahead.

marlow.story.limp.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I hear his dragging boot squeak. It is the same sound from that alley night you went blind.

marlow.twist.tape.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I lifted the backing and found a taped spool wired inside the frame.

client.got.speaker: client
text: You have it, good. Do not open it, do not linger. Get out of there now.

client.checkin.speaker: client
text: Owl, talk to me. Where is she, have you got clear of the hall yet?

marlow.outro.win.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I am out on the street with the Widow. I can hear the traffic and breathe again.

client.tape.speaker: client
text: Leave Owl blinded in the alley, Theo says. Make sure he never sees who paid.

marlow.epilogue.ask.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, that is Theo ordering the hit that took your eyes. What do I do with it? Burn it, or send it?

marlow.epilogue.burn.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, the tape is ash now. I burned the spool in the sink and pocketed the portrait.

marlow.epilogue.send.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I mailed the spool to the papers. I kept a copy and I have the portrait.

client.after.burn.speaker: client
text: Good, Owl. The past stays buried, and you will be paid by morning.

client.after.send.speaker: client
text: You fool, Owl. You have ruined me, but the truth had to come out.

marlow.nudge.office.speaker: marlow
text: The laughing widow is in the velvet room, boss. Want me to head there?

marlow.nudge.take.speaker: marlow
text: It's right here, boss. Want me to take the laughing widow?

marlow.nudge.exit.speaker: marlow
text: We have it. Back to the foyer and out, boss.

marlow.story.grand_hall.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I see a wide hall. I hear pigeons cooing in the vents and Theo's old matchbook by the bench.

marlow.story.cloak_room.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I see rows of coats. I hear hangers clinking and smell mothballs and rain.

marlow.story.velvet_room.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I see the Widow smiling on the wall. I hear the frame buzzing faintly and spot Theo's initials scratched behind.

marlow.story.stair_gallery.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I see dusty stairs and photo flashes. I hear my own steps ringing on metal rails.

marlow.lore.client.0.speaker: marlow
text: Theo is the client, boss. He was your partner once before he sold you out.

marlow.lore.client.1.speaker: marlow
text: Theo is the voice on the spool, boss. He ordered the alley hit that blinded you.

marlow.lore.guard.0.speaker: marlow
text: Milo is the guard, boss. He walks nights with a bad knee and a squeaky boot.

marlow.lore.guard.1.speaker: marlow
text: Milo was a picture hanger here, boss. He knows every back hall like his own kitchen.

marlow.lore.owner.0.speaker: marlow
text: Madame Voss is the owner, boss. She built the Meridian to show her late husband's portraits.

marlow.lore.item.0.speaker: marlow
text: The Laughing Widow is the item, boss. It is a small smiling lady everyone comes to see.

marlow.lore.history.0.speaker: marlow
text: This is inspired by a 1911 case where a worker stole a famous smile portrait from a closed museum, boss.

marlow.lore.marlow.0.speaker: marlow
text: I'm Marlow, boss. Your eyes.
